43-3011.00:2474.short: Log call outcomes, promises to pay, disputes and customer credit facts in Excel tracker and AFAS notes.

steps.what: Write call and mail outcome into Excel collections tracker

loop.input: Officer's short call notes or debtor mail thread
loop.output: Structured record: outcome code, promised amount, promised date, dispute reason
loop.check: Amount and invoice numbers must match open items in AFAS; date must be in the future; officer confirms on screen
loop.stop: One pass per note; if fields fail the check the form stays blank for manual entry
loop.why_not_simpler: Notes and mails are free text; a plain form works but costs typing time on every call

steps.what: Copy promises and dispute status into AFAS debtor notes
Update customer facts: KvK changes, insurer limit, payment behaviour
Compile weekly collections status for Controller and sales

43-3011.00:2474.design: Replace the Excel collections tracker with a small case app on the governed data platform that reads AFAS open items through the API and writes notes back to AFAS debtor records. A bounded model step turns call notes into structured outcomes the officer confirms; a nightly job checks KvK changes and insurer limits; the Power BI finance model gets a collections page instead of the weekly mail.
43-3011.00:2474.previous_blocker: The tracker sits between AFAS and Outlook and nobody owned an integration; free-text notes could not be structured cheaply.
43-3011.00:2474.enabler_now: AFAS has a REST connector, AI-assisted coding makes a small case app a matter of days, and models extract amount and date from short notes reliably enough to confirm in one click.
43-3011.00:2474.still_hard: Keeping one source of truth when sales and operations also talk to the same shipper; insurer portals may lack an API.
43-3011.00:2474.human_edge: Judging whether a promise is credible and what a customer's tone means for the next step.

ambition.what: Weekly credit-limit review per top-50 shipper instead of a yearly check

43-3011.00:2474.altitude: The officer stops typing logs and spends the saved two hours a week reviewing broken promises and limit changes, with the right to propose limit changes to the Controller.

reach.task: Posting receipts and credit notes in AFAS
reach.learn: Which notes they need to match payments to promises
How promises to pay can feed the weekly cash forecast

evidence.claim: 30% of Dutch finance professionals name manual Excel, mail and export work as the biggest cash-flow problem
AFAS Profit exposes debtor data through REST connectors
Credit scoring of natural persons is high-risk under the AI Act; sole-trader hauliers fall in scope

assumptions: The tracker today is an Excel file on SharePoint
unknowns: Which credit insurer is used and whether it has an API
Whether AFAS debtor notes are used by bookkeepers today
How many active debtors are sole traders
research_questions: How many minutes per day go to logging, measured over one week?
Can AFAS debtor notes be written through the API with the current licence?
Do officers accept confirming a pre-filled note rather than typing?

43-3011.00:2475.short: Send reminders and final notices by mail, phone debtors who stay late to get payment.

steps.what: Select invoices due for first or second reminder
Write and send standard reminder mails in Outlook
Prepare final notice with statutory interest and EUR 40 compensation
Gather history, delivery proof and disputes before a call

loop.input: Open items, last notes, recent mail thread with the debtor
loop.output: Half-page call brief: amounts, past promises, open disputes, suggested ask
loop.check: Amounts and invoice numbers are filled by code from AFAS, the model only writes the summary text; officer reads before calling
loop.stop: One draft per call; on failure show the raw history
loop.why_not_simpler: Mail threads are free text; the amounts part is deterministic already

steps.what: Phone the debtor and agree payment or next step

43-3011.00:2475.design: Configure AFAS dunning with Noordhaven's reminder sequence and Dutch/English templates so standard reminders go out without touch; a deterministic generator on the data platform drafts final notices with BW 6:119a interest and the EUR 40 minimum, which the officer approves. Before each call the case app shows a brief built from AFAS data plus a bounded model summary of the mail thread.
43-3011.00:2475.previous_blocker: Reminders were tailored by hand because templates and contract terms varied per shipper, and interest calculations were done in Excel.
43-3011.00:2475.enabler_now: AFAS dunning is standard functionality; statutory interest is pure rules; models summarise mail threads well enough for a brief a person reads.
43-3011.00:2475.still_hard: Customer-specific payment terms must be clean in AFAS first; calls stay human and take most of the time.
43-3011.00:2475.human_edge: Persuading a shipper on the phone, reading their situation and keeping the commercial relationship intact.

ambition.what: Small shippers under EUR 5k get a timely reminder sequence for the first time instead of being skipped

43-3011.00:2475.altitude: The officer's week shifts from writing letters to calls with the 30-40 accounts that matter, with the right to approve every final notice.

reach.learn: How claimed interest and EUR 40 charges are posted and reversed

reach.task: Setting payment terms in customer contracts
reach.learn: Which non-standard terms break the dunning sequence

evidence.claim: B2B statutory commercial interest runs from the due date or 30 days after invoice; at least EUR 40 compensation is due without a reminder
Errors in the first letter, interest or costs surface only later in court
Wki registration covers parties chasing on another's behalf; chasing own invoices is not described as covered
Standard reminders with model-assisted wording run at high autonomy

assumptions: Noordhaven sends its own reminders, not through an agency
Debtors are reachable by mail addresses held in AFAS
unknowns: Whether Noordhaven's general terms set their own interest or cost clauses
Share of debtors that are sole traders or partnerships
Whether AFAS dunning module is licensed
research_questions: How many reminders a month are sent today and how many are hand-edited?
Do customer contracts deviate from standard payment terms, and how often?
Does an automatic first reminder lower days overdue in a four-week pilot on small shippers?

43-3011.00:2473.short: Export AFAS open items, build ageing and priority list in Excel, check payments, pick whom to chase.

steps.what: Export open debtor items from AFAS to Excel
Build ageing buckets and priority list in Excel
Check bank statements and disputes so paid items are not chased
Decide whom to chase today and in what order

43-3011.00:2473.design: A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform pulls AFAS open items and the latest bank match status each morning, applies ageing and priority rules (amount, days overdue, broken promise, insurer limit) and fills a daily work queue in the collections case app plus a Power BI ageing page. AFAS auto-matching is tuned first so paid items drop out before the list is built.
43-3011.00:2473.previous_blocker: The ageing logic lived in one person's Excel; AFAS reports were not trusted because bank matching lagged.
43-3011.00:2473.enabler_now: AFAS bank-statement auto-match rules can be configured, and AI coding makes a rule-based priority job cheap to build and change.
43-3011.00:2473.still_hard: Unmatched receipts still need a bookkeeper; priority rules need tuning with the officer's judgement for the first months.
43-3011.00:2473.human_edge: Knowing which shipper pays late but always pays, and which silence means trouble.

ambition.what: Daily re-prioritised chase list instead of a weekly Excel refresh

43-3011.00:2473.altitude: The officer starts the day with a ready queue and owns the priority rules with the Controller, adjusting weights monthly.

reach.learn: Which match rules leave the most unmatched receipts
How the ageing feed supports the bad-debt provision

evidence.claim: AFAS matches bank lines on payment reference, IBAN, invoice number and oldest-first sums; misses go to a person
81% of Dutch finance professionals explain DSO after the fact

assumptions: Bank statements reach AFAS daily from Rabobank
Power BI AFAS extract can be extended with debtor tables
unknowns: Current share of receipts matched automatically in AFAS
Number of open debtor items per month
research_questions: What share of the chase list today turns out already paid?
Would a daily refresh change who is called first, tested on four past weeks?
Is the nightly Power BI extract fresh enough or is an intraday pull needed?

43-3011.00:18559.short: Answer shipper mails and calls about invoices, statements, delivery proof and disputed charges.

steps.what: Read and sort incoming mails in the debtors mailbox

loop.output: Request type (invoice copy, statement, POD, dispute, payment notice, other) and invoice numbers
loop.check: Invoice numbers must exist in AFAS for that debtor; low confidence goes to the officer's queue
loop.stop: One pass per mail; unknown or mixed requests go to the human queue
loop.why_not_simpler: Mail rules on keywords miss Dutch/English free text and remittance mails without structure

steps.what: Look up invoice, statement and proof of delivery
Reply with documents or an explanation

loop.input: Classified request, account data and attached documents
loop.output: Reply draft in the customer's language
loop.check: Standard document requests use fixed templates and send automatically; any explanation text is a draft the officer approves
loop.stop: One draft; if documents are missing, route to the officer
loop.why_not_simpler: Explanations of charges and surcharges need free wording; document requests alone do not

steps.what: Handle disputes: ask sales or operations, request credit note

43-3011.00:18559.design: Put a bounded classifier on the shared debtors mailbox that tags requests and invoice numbers, after which deterministic code pulls statements and invoice copies from AFAS and proof of delivery from SharePoint and sends standard replies from templates. Explanations get a model draft for approval, and disputes open a case in the collections app that routes to sales or operations and to a bookkeeper for credit notes.
43-3011.00:18559.previous_blocker: Requests arrive as free text in mixed Dutch and English, and documents sit in three places, so rules alone could not sort them.
43-3011.00:18559.enabler_now: Models classify short business mails reliably within a checkable output, and AFAS plus SharePoint can be read by API.
43-3011.00:18559.still_hard: Proof of delivery may sit in a transport system outside the listed ones; disputes over damage and surcharges need operations input.
43-3011.00:18559.human_edge: Resolving a disputed charge fairly while keeping the shipper as a customer.

ambition.what: Self-service statement and invoice copy link for shippers, sent automatically on request

43-3011.00:18559.altitude: Routine document requests disappear from the officer's day; they gain the right to log dispute causes and report them monthly to sales and operations.

reach.learn: Which dispute types end in credit notes and why
How dispute causes such as surcharges erode customer margin

evidence.claim: Account questions suit an agent with a gate that sends statements, invoice copies and proof of delivery
Genpact's AR suite promises up to 30% faster disputes, as indicative estimates only

assumptions: A shared debtors mailbox exists in Outlook
Proof of delivery is stored as files reachable from SharePoint
unknowns: Where proof of delivery documents actually live
Volume of debtor mails per week and share that are simple document requests
Whether customers accept auto-sent statements
research_questions: What share of a month's debtor mails are pure document requests?
Can proof of delivery be found by invoice or order number without a person?
How accurate is classification on 200 past mails, Dutch and English mixed?

43-3011.00:2478.short: Call and mail overdue shippers, explain the claim, and agree payment, a plan or a return.

steps.what: Build today's call list from the AFAS ageing in Excel
Gather invoice, proof of delivery, claims and past mails per debtor

loop.input: Outlook threads and claim notes linked to the debtor
loop.output: one-paragraph summary of open disputes and last promises, with links to source mails
loop.check: every claim in the summary must cite a mail or AFAS record; invoice numbers and amounts are checked against AFAS
loop.stop: one pass per debtor, max 50 mails; if citations fail, show the raw thread list instead
loop.why_not_simpler: Dispute reasons and promises sit in free-text mails; rules cannot extract them.

steps.what: Call or mail the customer, hear the reason, persuade, negotiate
Record outcome, promise-to-pay date and follow-up in AFAS

loop.input: officer's short typed or dictated call note
loop.output: structured fields: outcome code, promised amount, date, dispute cause
loop.check: officer confirms fields in one screen before save; amounts must not exceed open balance
loop.stop: single pass; on parse failure the officer fills the form manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Call notes are free text; a form alone already helps and is the fallback.

steps.what: Confirm agreement or payment plan by mail and set reminder

43-3011.00:2478.design: A collections workbench on the governed data platform reads AFAS ageing nightly, ranks accounts and assembles a dispute file per debtor with a bounded model summary of Outlook threads. The officer calls with the file open, confirms model-extracted outcome fields that write back to AFAS, and sends template confirmations; Finance Director approves plans above a set amount.
43-3011.00:2478.previous_blocker: Dispute evidence is spread over mailboxes, SharePoint and AFAS, and summarising free-text mails needed a person; bespoke tooling was too costly for one officer.
43-3011.00:2478.enabler_now: AI-assisted coding makes a small workbench cheap to build, and language models can summarise mail threads with citations that are checked against AFAS.
43-3011.00:2478.still_hard: Proof of delivery and damage-claim status often live with operations in other systems; summaries that miss a promise can damage a relationship.
43-3011.00:2478.human_edge: Reading a shipper's real situation on the phone, choosing when to press and when to give time, and keeping a commercial relationship intact.

ambition.what: A promise-to-pay or plan agreed with every overdue shipper above EUR 1,000 each week, not only the largest accounts.

43-3011.00:2478.altitude: Most of the week becomes conversations with prepared files; the officer gains the right to agree plans within a limit without asking.

reach.learn: How promise-to-pay dates should be coded so they feed the forecast reliably.

evidence.claim: 30% of Dutch finance professionals name manual work in Excel and mail as the biggest cash-flow problem; half plan cash-in at most two weeks ahead.
AR suites promise higher collector productivity and faster disputes, but as indicative estimates with people on complex decisions.
Summarising mail threads with citations is feasible with current language models.

assumptions: Most debtors are business shippers, not consumers.
Dispute mails sit in a shared collections mailbox the platform may read.
AFAS allows write-back of collection notes via its connectors.
unknowns: Where proof of delivery and damage claims are stored and who owns them.
Whether a shared collections mailbox exists or mails are in personal inboxes.
The approval limit for payment plans today.
research_questions: What share of overdue amount is disputed versus simply late, by cause?
How long does the officer spend finding evidence before a call today (time a sample of 20)?
Can AFAS GetConnectors expose open items and accept collection notes in near real time?
Do model summaries of 30 real threads miss any promise or dispute the officer knows of?

43-3011.00:2472.short: Import bank statements, match payments to open invoices in AFAS, and clear the mismatches.

steps.what: Download Rabobank statement and import it into AFAS
Match payments on reference, IBAN, invoice number and amounts
Find invoices for unmatched payments using remittance mails

loop.input: remittance mails and PDF advices from the payer
loop.output: list of invoice numbers and amounts per payment
loop.check: invoice numbers must exist and be open for that debtor; amounts must sum to the payment within a small tolerance
loop.stop: one pass per payment; if the sum check fails, send to the officer's queue unmatched
loop.why_not_simpler: Remittance advices arrive in many free formats; rules match only structured references.

steps.what: Book short payments, discounts and unapplied cash; flag disputes
Report daily cash received to controller

43-3011.00:2472.design: Turn on the automatic Rabobank feed and AFAS auto-match rules, then route the remaining unmatched payments to a small queue where a bounded model loop reads remittance mails and proposes matches that must pass sum and open-item checks. The officer approves proposals and books differences; a Power BI page replaces the daily cash sheet.
43-3011.00:2472.previous_blocker: Remittance advices come as free-format mails and PDFs, so the tail of unmatched payments needed a person reading each one.
43-3011.00:2472.enabler_now: AFAS already matches on rules [S4]; models can now extract invoice numbers from messy advices, with arithmetic checks catching errors.
43-3011.00:2472.still_hard: Netted payments, credit notes and payer entities that differ from the invoiced entity still need judgement and sometimes a call.
43-3011.00:2472.human_edge: Deciding whether a short payment is a dispute, an agreed discount or an error, and whom to ask.
43-3011.00:2472.altitude: Cash posting shrinks to a short daily review; the officer spends the time on calls, and short payments surface the same day as disputes.

reach.learn: Which matching rules leave the most residue so rules are tuned once for both roles.

evidence.claim: AFAS matches bank lines on payment reference, IBAN, invoice number and oldest-first sums; misses go to a person.
Receivables suites expect up to 80% touchless cash application, as indicative estimates.

assumptions: The Rabobank-AFAS statement link can be automated.
Customers mostly pay by bank transfer with some reference.
unknowns: Current auto-match rate in AFAS and number of unmatched lines per day.
Whether auto-match is already switched on and how its rules are set.
How remittance advices arrive (mail, portal, PDF).
research_questions: What share of last month's receipts did AFAS match without a person?
Of the unmatched ones, how many had a usable remittance advice?
Does the extraction loop reach the right invoices on a sample of 100 historic unmatched payments?

43-3011.00:2484.short: When shippers stay silent, put them on credit hold, inform sales, and hand files to agency or lawyer.

steps.what: Select non-responding accounts that passed the reminder sequence
Put customer on credit hold and inform sales and operations
Decide: agency, lawyer, write-off or another try
Compile hand-over file: invoices, reminders, mails, interest and costs

loop.output: chronology and dispute summary for the lawyer, with citations
loop.check: interest per BW 6:119a and EUR 40 compensation are calculated in code, not by the model; every chronology line cites a document
loop.stop: one draft per file; officer edits or rejects; on failed citation the chronology is left blank for manual entry
loop.why_not_simpler: The chronology and dispute summary come from free-text mails; documents and calculations are deterministic.

steps.what: Send file to agency or lawyer and track the outcome

43-3011.00:2484.design: An escalation workflow on the data platform flags accounts that finished the reminder sequence, proposes a credit hold that the officer approves and that notifies sales and planning in Teams. For accounts the officer sends on, it builds the hand-over file from AFAS and SharePoint with code-calculated interest and costs and a cited model chronology, checks the agency's Wki registration, and tracks case status.
43-3011.00:2484.previous_blocker: Files had to be assembled by hand from several systems, and interest and cost calculations were done in Excel each time.
43-3011.00:2484.enabler_now: AI-coded document assembly is cheap; models can draft a cited chronology; legal-step drafting tools exist in the Dutch market [S1].
43-3011.00:2484.still_hard: Errors in the first letter or calculations only surface in court [S5]; the decision to escalate weighs commercial relationships.
43-3011.00:2484.human_edge: Choosing escalation against the value of the customer relationship and agreeing it with sales and the Finance Director.

ambition.what: A weekly escalation review of every account past the reminder sequence, instead of escalating only when someone notices.

43-3011.00:2484.altitude: The officer chairs a short weekly escalation review with sales and approves files instead of building them.

reach.task: Approval of legal escalation and write-offs
reach.learn: The thresholds and evidence the director needs so approvals fit one screen.

evidence.claim: Syncasso turns a file into a draft summons in two minutes; handling time fell from 165 to 62 minutes, vendor's figure.
Early file errors such as a wrong first letter or miscalculated interest surface only in court.
Statutory commercial interest runs from the due date or 30 days after invoice; at least EUR 40 compensation is due without reminder.
Since 1 October 2026 no collection costs or further interest are owed by natural persons if the reminding third party is unregistered.

assumptions: Noordhaven uses an external collection agency and a law firm.
Credit hold can be set as a block in AFAS that order intake respects.
unknowns: Which agencies and lawyers are used and whether the agencies are Wki-registered.
How many accounts are escalated per year and their value.
Whether a credit hold actually stops transport orders in operations' planning system.
research_questions: How often did a hand-over file in the last year come back incomplete or with wrong calculations?
Does the agency or lawyer accept a structured file upload instead of mail?
Do sales and operations act on a hold notice today, and how quickly?

43-3011.00:2480.short: Keep debtor records current: address and contact changes, mergers, closures and bankruptcies.

steps.what: Pick up change notices from mail, returned post and bounces

loop.input: incoming mails in the collections mailbox
loop.output: change request with type (address, contact, IBAN, name, closure) and proposed values
loop.check: debtor must be found in AFAS by KvK number or domain; low confidence goes to the queue as unclassified
loop.stop: one pass per mail; fallback is the officer's normal inbox
loop.why_not_simpler: Change notices arrive as free-text mails and signatures; no fixed format to parse.

steps.what: Check the change against the KvK register
Update the debtor master record in AFAS
Handle closure or bankruptcy: block credit, claim with the curator

43-3011.00:2480.design: A mailbox classifier and a KvK lookup feed a change queue; verified address and contact changes are written to AFAS after one-click approval, and IBAN or name changes need a second person. A nightly KvK and insolvency-register check on all active debtors raises bankruptcy alerts so credit is blocked early.
43-3011.00:2480.previous_blocker: Changes arrive by unstructured mail and each needs a register lookup; volume was too low to justify a build.
43-3011.00:2480.enabler_now: Cheap custom code with AI coding, KvK APIs and a bounded classifier for free-text mails.
43-3011.00:2480.still_hard: Fraudulent IBAN change requests need strict four-eyes control; group structures and mergers need judgement.
43-3011.00:2480.human_edge: Spotting a suspicious change request and judging what a merger or bankruptcy means for open items.

ambition.what: Daily insolvency and KvK-change monitoring of all active shippers, with automatic credit-hold proposals.

43-3011.00:2480.altitude: Record keeping becomes a short approval queue; the officer gains early warning on failing customers.

reach.learn: Which insolvency signals should move an account into the provision.

evidence.claim: KvK lookups and priority lists suit deterministic software.
Classifying change mails with a bounded model step is feasible.

assumptions: Noordhaven has or can get a KvK API subscription.
Sole-trader hauliers' data is personal data under AVG and handled within the purpose of debtor administration.
unknowns: How many debtor changes per month occur today.
Whether AFAS debtor records hold KvK numbers consistently.
Current four-eyes rule for IBAN changes.
research_questions: How many bankruptcies among debtors were spotted late in the last two years and at what loss?
What share of active debtors have a valid KvK number in AFAS?
Has the company received a fake IBAN-change request?
